items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: About your touring after that summer with Buzzin' Fredeson Harris.

ctx.x: No. I'll show them to you; they're wonderful. I have all the first things that I wore with them, except the shoes and the dress. You were asking me about -
About your touring after that summer with Buzzin' Fredeson Harris. The home talent show - you were going to tell me about the home talent show.
Well, in Washington, Pennsylvania - I went there and she didn't know where I was so she found out where I was through a friend.
